label: Fibonacci pivot R1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Fibonacci first resistance pivot, P + 0.382 × the previous UTC month’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot R2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Fibonacci second resistance pivot, P + 0.618 × the previous UTC month’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot S1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Fibonacci first support pivot, P − 0.382 × the previous UTC month’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot S2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Fibonacci second support pivot, P − 0.618 × the previous UTC month’s range

label: Pivot (previous UTC month)
gloss: the floor pivot, (the previous UTC month’s high + low + close) / 3

label: Pivot R1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the first floor resistance pivot, 2P − the previous UTC month’s low

label: Pivot R2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the second floor resistance pivot, P + the previous UTC month’s range

label: Pivot R3 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the third floor resistance pivot, the previous UTC month’s high + 2 × (P − that month’s low)

label: Pivot R4 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the fourth floor resistance pivot, 3P + (the previous UTC month’s high − 3 × that month’s low)

label: Pivot R5 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the fifth floor resistance pivot, 4P + (the previous UTC month’s high − 4 × that month’s low)

label: Pivot S1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the first floor support pivot, 2P − the previous UTC month’s high

label: Pivot S2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the second floor support pivot, P − the previous UTC month’s range

label: Pivot S3 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the third floor support pivot, the previous UTC month’s low − 2 × (that month’s high − P)

label: Pivot S4 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the fourth floor support pivot, 3P − (3 × the previous UTC month’s high − that month’s low)

label: Pivot S5 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the fifth floor support pivot, 4P − (4 × the previous UTC month’s high − that month’s low)

label: Woodie pivot (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie pivot, (the previous UTC month’s high + low + 2 × the current UTC month’s open) / 4; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot R1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie first resistance pivot, 2 × the Woodie pivot − the previous UTC month’s low; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot R2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie second resistance pivot, the Woodie pivot + the previous UTC month’s range; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot R3 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie third resistance pivot, the previous UTC month’s high + 2 × (the Woodie pivot − that month’s low); absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot R4 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie fourth resistance pivot, Woodie R3 + the previous UTC month’s range; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot S1 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie first support pivot, 2 × the Woodie pivot − the previous UTC month’s high; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot S2 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie second support pivot, the Woodie pivot − the previous UTC month’s range; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot S3 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie third support pivot, the previous UTC month’s low − 2 × (that month’s high − the Woodie pivot); absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Woodie pivot S4 (previous UTC month)
gloss: the Woodie fourth support pivot, Woodie S3 − the previous UTC month’s range; absent until the current UTC month has its first composite

label: Pivot
gloss: the floor pivot, (the previous UTC day’s high + low + close) / 3

label: Camarilla pivot R1 (previous UTC quarter)
gloss: the Camarilla first resistance level, the previous UTC quarter’s close + 1.1 × that quarter’s range / 12; absent until every month of the previous UTC quarter has a completed composite

label: Camarilla pivot R2 (previous UTC quarter)
gloss: the Camarilla second resistance level, the previous UTC quarter’s close + 1.1 × that quarter’s range / 6; absent until every month of the previous UTC quarter has a completed composite

label: Camarilla pivot R3 (previous UTC quarter)
gloss: the Camarilla third resistance level, the previous UTC quarter’s close + 1.1 × that quarter’s range / 4; absent until every month of the previous UTC quarter has a completed composite

label: Camarilla pivot R4 (previous UTC quarter)
gloss: the Camarilla fourth resistance level, the previous UTC quarter’s close + 1.1 × that quarter’s range / 2; absent until every month of the previous UTC quarter has a completed composite

label: Camarilla pivot R5 (previous UTC quarter)
gloss: the Camarilla fifth resistance level, (the previous UTC quarter’s high / its low) × its close; absent until every month of the previous UTC quarter has a completed composite
